hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook for ETH/phiEth pools that implements 1:1 swapping between ETH and phiEth (a liquid ETH wrapper). It takes the input from the PoolManager, wraps or unwraps ETH via the phiEth contract, settles the output, and returns a full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass the AMM curve entirely. Liquidity additions always revert.
